description: This file defines a React component for a Watchlist page, implementing client-side CRUD operations with store integration for managing symbols, notes, and sorting features. It includes UI for adding, editing, deleting, and sorting watchlist items, along with accessibility considerations.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Increments the internal state version to trigger re-render, forcing React to refresh the component with latest store data.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Validates and adds a new symbol to the watchlist, updating UI and state accordingly.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Initiates inline editing mode for a specific watchlist item by setting edit state and focusing input.

methods.name: cancelEdit
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing inline edit, resetting edit states and statuses.

methods.name: saveEdit
methods.description: Saves the inline edits by updating the symbol and note in the store, then refreshes the list.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Prompts user for delete confirmation and removes the symbol from the store if confirmed.
